site.name: Somnia Magna
site.page_title: Somnia Magna | Bringing dreams to life
site.description: Curated day and night experiences in Toronto, built around people and community instead of the bar.

about.heading: About
about.body: Somnia Magna is Latin for "Big Dreams". SOMA came out of a need for third spaces that didn't just involve drinks and a loud room. Originating in Toronto, SOMA aims to create third spaces through events, partnerships, and community-building.

pillars.title: Events
pillars.body: Curated and personalized events for specific niches.

pillars.title: Partnerships
pillars.body: We work with sponsors, venues, and creators who care about the same crowd we do, and build something that fits both sides.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.body: Every event is a reason to come back. Our goal is to fill the map with a community across the globe that are dedicated to building third-spaces. We aim to do this through sharing photos and events.

items.title: More than a bar tab
items.body: Drinks can be there. They're never the plan.

items.title: Doors open
items.body: We don't build on velvet ropes. If it sounds like your kind of night, you're invited.

items.title: Room for everyone
items.body: Nobody should have to wonder whether they belong at one of our events.

events.title: Events
events.lead: Gatherings planned around what people actually want to do, from the venue to the smallest detail. Day or night.

items.title: Our first gathering
items.blurb: Follow @somniamagna on Instagram to hear about it first.

partners.title: Partnerships
partners.lead: We work with sponsors, venues and creators who care about the same crowd we do, and build something that fits both sides.
partners.body: Sponsors, venues and creators: if you want to reach people looking for something better to do with their evenings, let's talk.

community.title: Community
community.lead: Every event is a reason to come back. Tap a photo to see where it was taken.
